items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was Lana Turner’s old girl.

ctx.x: Yeah. I was with a whole bunch of people, so that – I couldn’t see me as anything on that. But the next one . . .
Yeah. I was all through that. I was her maid or something or other. I don’t see it on t.v. or nothing. I’m looking all the time. I’m looking for it.
